messages:
anika: Quick report — encountered SSE chunk-ordering on immediate reconnect in sampleapp (node-sdk 1.4.x). If client kills and reconnects <300ms, parser sometimes emits combined data without blank-line delimiter.

anika: Minimal repro: start stream, send two events, kill client, reconnect fast. Occasionally the second event's line from old conn is prepended to first event of new conn and parsed as one JSON blob.

pete: Is the socket closing with FIN or abrupt? That changes behavior.

anika: Mostly clean close but racey. tcpdump shows no delimiter between packets sometimes.

omar: Simple mitigation: on socket close call parser.reset() and optionally emit a comment marker for partial. Also treat line starting with `event:` or `id:` as implicit start-of-event.

anika: I pushed tiny fix to sampleapp and node-sdk branch, tests added for fast reconnect. CI flagged one flaky case; will harden.

ci-bot: Created issue DEVEX-2109: "sse: parser buffer survives fast reconnect -> merged events"

anika: Will follow up with backport to 1.3.x and docs note about immediate-reconnect edge case.
